summary: Akebia Therapeutics filed an 8-K on June 30, 2026, disclosing results from a planned interim analysis of the VOICE trial (N=2,116) for Vafseo (vadadustat) vs standard-of-care ESA in dialysis-dependent CKD anemia patients. The trial met pre-defined stopping criteria by establishing non-inferiority and superiority on the composite primary endpoint of all-cause mortality and all-cause hospitalization (win odds 1.16, 95% CI 1.06-1.28, p=0.0016), with a significant reduction in hospitalizations (IRR 0.90). The Independent Data Monitoring Committee recommended stopping the trial. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is present; this is a clinical trial update.
